actualScienceFindings.ligandDonor: One explicitly labelled O site on coral Tartrat fragment has exactly two separate dots before binding. This is a selected donor pair, not all oxygen electrons or a whole tartrate formula.
actualScienceFindings.acceptor: Exactly one empty outline next to Cu²⁺ before binding, with Freies Orbital leader. No other empty orbital outlines, d-shell diagram or complete coordination geometry.
actualScienceFindings.donationDirection: Single red curved arrow from O pair toward Cu²⁺ acceptor.
actualScienceFindings.sharedPair: Exactly two dots in one visible Cu–O interaction after binding; no extra free-pair copy and no Cu oxidation-state change.
actualScienceFindings.boundedScope: Large Modellausschnitt label in standalone image; no complete Fehling-Komplex, claimed ligand count or exact full stoichiometry.
actualScienceFindings.scienceScopeLimit: This is an own qualitative donor/acceptor model of one possible local Cu²⁺–O coordination interaction in tartrate context, not measured solution geometry or a complete structural model of Fehling species.

actualVisualFindings.style: Warm cream/orange, bold dark outlines and smiling blue/coral characters preserve good prior friendly comic landscape elements.
